title: THE SCOOTER SQUAD IS BORN! 🛵
topic: The mystery rider is finally revealed and rewards the family.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I BET YOU ALL THOUGHT I WAS JUST SNEAKING OUT TO CAUSE TROUBLE IN THE MIDDLE OF THE NIGHT!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Nix, we were worried sick about you! [beat] Seeing you on that scooter delivering medicine to Nani was one thing, but buying scooters for everyone?

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: Exactly, son! [beat] Where on earth did you get the money to buy an entire fleet of electric scooters for the whole family at once?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Remember that Midnight Ghost delivery app everyone was talking about? [beat] Well, I was the one who coded it and did the first five hundred deliveries myself!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Wait, you are telling me you built a logistics empire while we were all asleep? [beat] That is actually impressive even by my high standards!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: So that is why you were always covered in grease and drinking energy drinks before breakfast! [beat] You are a total nerd, Nix, but I love the new wheels!

lines.speaker: milli
lines.text: I do not care about the app! [beat] Look at this pink one with the sparkly streamers! [beat] It even has a custom horn that sounds like a dragon!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: My old knees feel twenty years younger on this motorized beast! [beat] I am going to race your grandfather to the grocery store right now!

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: You are on, woman! [beat] But do not cry when I leave you in the dust with my turbo-charged midnight black edition scooter!

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: I suppose I should stop telling the neighbors that you were out joining a secret street gang! [beat] This is much better for the family reputation, you rascal.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: This is literally like a real-life level up! [beat] Nix, you have to show me how you bypassed the speed limiter on these things tonight!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The Midnight Scooter was just the beginning! [beat] Now that we are all mobile, the whole neighborhood belongs to our family squad!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And so, the mystery of the midnight rider ended with a fleet of scooters and a very [beat] very confused neighborhood watch patrol.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: FIRST ONE TO THE PARK HAS TO PAY FOR LUNCH! [beat] LET IS GO BEFORE THE SUN SETS!
